description: Receives locally trained model weights from a client node and stages them in the aggregation buffer. Weights remain in the buffer until /model/aggregate is called.

response_200.message: Update staged. Call POST /model/aggregate to run FedAvg.

detail.msg: ensure this value is greater than or equal to 1

notes: The coef array must have exactly 30 elements matching the 30 model features. sample_count is used for weighted averaging during aggregation (FedAvg). scaler_mean and scaler_scale are optional but recommended; if omitted, the server retains its current scaler values. Multiple submissions from the same client_id before aggregation will overwrite the previous entry in the buffer.
